getRoom creates a room for any name a client joins and rooms are never deleted, each retaining up to 50 messages of 2000 chars; a client can join unlimited distinct rooms and grow server memory without bound.
send() writes to every member without checking socket.bufferedAmount; a slow or non-reading client accumulates an unbounded outbound buffer as others chat, with no backpressure or disconnect.
There is no ping/pong heartbeat, so half-open connections (client vanished without a close frame) are never detected; they stay in room member sets and inflate /rooms counts indefinitely.
